thread.title: Video: Here Is Why Apple Shares Are Falling

author: thestreet.com
title: Video: Here Is Why Apple Shares Are Falling
text:
Shares of Apple ( AAPL ) moved lower Wednesday following a JPMorgan analyst note sounding the alarm on iPhone X orders.
JJ Kinahan, chief market strategist at TD Ameritrade wasn't alarmed by the slight pullback, especially given how much Apple shares have gained over the past year. 
Kinahan also discusses a new feature for TD Ameritrade clients: the ability to access U.S. equity markets on a 24-hour basis.
